Your electoral registration office will invite you to renew your registration. You may receive the invite by post or email.

This guide helps you use the online renewal service. It also explains other ways to renew your registration.

Renewing your registration means you can continue to vote in:

UK general elections

some UK-wide referendums

Different rules apply in Northern Ireland. Find out more from the Electoral Office for Northern Ireland.
